descriptions.w3d_d28b_girder_update_800943f8: Girder placement update: returns 20 while the timer 0x8006e71c is set, refreshes handle +728 from +220, runs the state at +684: 0 positions the girder 40 units ahead of the active worm at eye level along its yaw and sets the camera GirderCam; 6 goes to 1; 1 reads input and on a hit rebuilds points and heading; 2 and 3 track through 0x80095db4; 4 clamps the target, then places it with the Girder.Move sound or resets the pending values, and updates the state handle.
